records.product_name: Ingredients listed under Schedule IV, Schedule VI and Schedule VIII of Nutraceutical Regulations
records.official_source_scope: The Nutraceutical Regulations' Schedules IV/VI/VIII are distinct ingredient classes, not one defined as-sold substance.

Extract profile, quality marker, usage and permitted source
Actual supplier grade/COA and complete formulation
CTR applicable exact finished or ingredient article

records.official_source_scope: A functional-ingredient premix is a quantified multi-ingredient formulation, not a single schedule substance.

Every ingredient's individual regulatory schedule
Finished form, processing, claimed use and dosage
Final product contaminant basis and lot tests
